chapters.title: BC Talent Program Overview - Three Initiatives

features.name: ReSKILL Program
features.description: A talent program that brings people from outside the partner ecosystem (end users, accountants, supply chain experts, .NET developers) and reskills them to become Business Central professionals. The program has been in market for one year and consists of recruitment, product training, professional skills training, individual coaching, and community engagement.
caveats: Recruitment is an optional service within the program

features.name: Case-Based Learning Platform
features.description: A modern way of learning where trainees can learn at their own pace through specific scenarios, reading documents, watching videos, and calling on teachers for help when stuck. Available for Business Central, Power Platform, and leads to certification.
caveats: Content available for developers and consultants as well as Power Platform

features.name: Virtual Classroom Training
features.description: Traditional classroom training where participants attend virtual sessions on a Monday morning and go through courses. Available for Business Central, Power Platform, and leads to certification.

features.name: Professional Skills Training Workshop
features.description: A 10-day virtual workshop conducted in half-day sessions focused on developing change agent skills including customer engagement mindset, requirement gathering, effective communication, pre-sale skills, and project methodology. Participants engage in virtual implementation scenarios and play customer roles.
caveats: Partners highlight this as the key differentiator in the program

features.name: Individual Coaching Program
features.description: One-on-one and small group coaching that starts before the new hire's first working day. Creates individualized plans with milestones and deliverables, tracks training completion, manages integration into business activities, provides weekly follow-up, addresses feedback, and manages retention.
caveats: Covers developers, finance consultants, and manufacturing specialists

features.name: Global New Hire Community
features.description: A safe space where new hires from the program worldwide can ask questions, meet like-minded peers, and access continuous learning opportunities. Includes best practice sessions from MVPs and Microsoft, new copilot content, professional skills development, and in-person meetups at the development center in Copenhagen.

features.name: Cross-Skill Program
features.description: A talent development initiative that retrains people who are already experienced in selling and implementing business applications but lack Business Central experience or product knowledge to become Business Central experts.

features.name: Upskill Program
features.description: A new talent development initiative for people fresh from academic institutions entering the ecosystem at the start of their careers. Provides product knowledge, professional skills, and foundational business knowledge in areas like accountancy, supply chain, or development.
